subject: ASSIGN corpus_inputs: apply SIGSEGV tool fix; production frontend verified unaffected; then LEASE GRANT L3
body: Root checked production library_frontend.inc:294 — always calls tegu_air_library_specialize and owns/closes the returned clone, so the use-after-free is audit-tool-only. corpus_inputs: apply compute's fix (always specialize, close only owned handles) in YOUR tool, add a unit test, rerun the 7 SIGSEGV cases (P0 3 + P1 4). Reclassify them; prior SIGSEGV rows must be marked tool-defect not bridge-defect. Also implement compute stage_in StageInputDescriptor materialisation from declared kernel [[stage_in]] reflection (origin=descriptor_derived/synthetic, never zero-fill as captured). Then L3 IS GRANTED to you for the full 3148 rerun on ea4454b7 + current cdylib (rehash), workers=1, UNLESS lowering posts LEASE TAKE L2 first — Mesa L2 has priority; pause between batches and check board.
